sections.controlBasis: Printed full 1,233-row named Base Salary / Benefits and Other / Expenses subtotals on physical page 75. Known cells are summed separately; a printed subtotal does not establish blank components as zero. Accepted-subset totals have different scope.
notes: The original is a scanned employee schedule with a pre-existing OCR layer. Independent Tesseract column OCR is compared against both positioned PDF readers; all 38 name and 10 monetary OCR disagreements were resolved against the rendered original and frozen as reader-specific exact-cell corrections. Whitespace around existing commas is normalized; literal initials and names are preserved. No job titles are published in this schedule, so positions remain missing.

The source explicitly combines Base Salary and Benefits and Other for remuneration. Benefits and Other includes group life, accidental-death/dismemberment and vehicle benefits, plus lump-sum leave balances, union gratuities and union overtime. The two rows with blank Base Salary have no numeric individual remuneration total and remain held.
sections.publicWarning: Richmond 2024 full-source known-cell sums minus printed named component controls: Base Salary +$30, Benefits and Other −$28, Expenses +$40. The full 1,233-row known pay-component sum is $148,586,882, $3 above printed combined named remuneration $148,586,879. Separately, the two printed pay-component subtotals add to $148,586,880, $1 above that printed combined named total. Cause unknown; published individual values are unchanged. Full-source component controls differ in scope from the 1,231 accepted composite-pay rows.

independentCrossReview.qualification: Unchanged original cells; unresolved known-cell residuals +$30 Base Salary, −$28 Benefits and Other, +$40 Expenses, +$3 vs combined printed named remuneration. Cause unknown.
